review_boundary.reason: No native create/spawn/wait/collect delegation facility was exposed; serial fallback used.

findings.observation: DerivativeSupremumEvidence is publicly constructible from caller-supplied operator_id, model_epoch, ball_radius, certified_q and nonzero evidence_reference. verify_with_evidence checks scalar/radius inequalities before is_certified=true; it does not independently verify a derivative enclosure over the full ball or bind exact map/preconditioner identity. root_error_bound uses ordinary f64 division.
findings.impact: Caller metadata can acquire certificate status without a verified derivative supremum. Banach's theorem itself is not refuted.
findings.repair: Opaque source-bound evidence; bind map G, invertible P, model digest/epoch, norm, center/radius, arithmetic backend and checker version. Replay derivative enclosure over complete ball. Outwardly enclose residual, (1-q)r and quotient. Unsupported callbacks remain EstimateOnly.

findings.observation: CertifiedNormalityWitness stores operator_key and model_epoch, but the consumer checks is_normal, dimension and beta only. Construction accepts skew-symmetry within 1e-14*(max_entry+1).
findings.impact: A same-dimension or stale witness may be consumed for another operator; approximate skewness is not exact normality.
findings.repair: Compare canonical operator digest, scaling, dimension and epoch at consumption. Require exact represented relation or outwardly enclose defect and spectral perturbation.

findings.observation: Public from_chebyshev_intervals accepts caller intervals and caller-selected GershgorinCertified. gershgorin_intervals uses ordinary row sums and ordinary endpoints. The generated declaration is not source-bound to a private verified enclosure; operator norm fallback also uses ordinary row sums.
findings.impact: Caller intervals/source labels can mint Certified without source-bound outward spectral inclusion.
findings.repair: Only a private VerifiedSpectralEnclosure can mint Certified. Use outward row sums/endpoints and validate the matrix class. Caller intervals/Ritz remain EstimateOnly.

findings.observation: Fixed-H, Moving-H and QR observers report Certified. Moving-H samples J,H,Hdot and integrates mu_H*dt with ordinary f64 then exp(); QR uses (I+dt J)Q and Gram-Schmidt with sampled alpha_max*dt. No full time-slab/roundoff enclosure is constructed in the reviewed paths.
findings.impact: Finite samples do not bound a continuous-time supremum over the full slab.
findings.repair: Current sample-based modes become EstimateOnly/SampledDiagnostic. Validated mode must enclose J,H,Hdot, SPD lower bound, eigenvalue, quadrature remainder, metric jumps, QR defect and rounding on every slab.

findings.observation: No HybridRouteAutomaton call site was found in the SwitchingSolver dispatch file. Live switching state is DriveState. The automaton is exported and independently testable.
findings.impact: README may imply an exported automaton governs live routing without evidence.
findings.repair: Integrate it into the real route path and add runtime traces, or mark it standalone/experimental and document DriveState.

findings.observation: Rust result has timing_authority=diagnostic_only, 126 rows (123 success,3 failure), 21 failed repetitions. All 900 matched rows are DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY with reason reference-disputed. Julia has 45 rows (44 Success,1 Unstable), one missing common-error value; it records exact Rust result SHA. Both timing authority fields are diagnostic_only.
findings.impact: Useful robustness diagnostics, not matched-achieved-error speedup or solver ranking evidence.
findings.repair: Resolve every disputed reference independently; pin clean source/binary/runner/corpus/reference/grid identities; rerun with achieved-error matching, uncertainty and complete failed/refused work accounting.

findings.observation: Report says Timing Authority diagnostic_only but Same-Host Speed Authority PASS.
findings.impact: PASS can be read as speed qualification although same-host proves identity only.
findings.repair: Rename to SAME_HOST_IDENTITY_CHECK; performance authority remains HOLD until reference and achieved-error gates pass.

findings.observation: Implementation/golden tests use SHA-256 over checkpoint index plus endpoint bit patterns; current test passes. The test name still says FNV/index-independent. Its comment cites EPOCH_001_AUTHORITY_DECISION.md, not found in current docs/research.
findings.impact: Old test failure is resolved; persisted identity semantics and authority provenance remain unresolved.
findings.repair: Find owner-approved authority or create an approved append-only decision. Specify serialization, endianness, usize conversion, IEEE bits, signed zero/nonfinite behavior, index inclusion, digest truncation and migration. Rename test accurately.

findings.observation: ProductionSolver::solve may return Ok with solution.success=false; consumers must inspect success, final_time, message and stats.accounting_complete.
findings.impact: Consumer can mistake partial accepted prefix for completed integration.
findings.repair: Add compatible checked outcome/helper and examples; test early exits.

findings.observation: README claims promotion gates passed, 23x-169x speedups, live HybridRouteAutomaton and broad zero-allocation/routing claims. Latest cross-solver data is diagnostic-only and live path uses DriveState.

findings.repair: Separate local diagnostic, achieved-error, cross-solver, rigorous enclosure and release claims. Bind figures to immutable current evidence.
